NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:nanny}{NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{SAY:nanny}It ain't gonna be me, you hear! Ain't me! So you might as well call it quits now!

{SAY:zombossicon}You both get to keep your jobs! What a relief, huh? I don't have to exile or freeze any of you!
{SAY:zombossicon}Hey, what's with the faces!? I thought you'd be happier about this!

{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting a massive army of imps approaching. It is no mystery who had sent them.
{SAY:hunterria}Do not worry, Iron mammoth. Hunterria is willing to form temporary pact with you.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Yeah, we wouldn't know yet, Leave her alone, Granny!
{SAY:hunterria}What Old Woman did is dishonorable. Punishing someone for something someone else do. It is injustice. It is betrayal.
{SAY:hunterria}And betrayal is what Hunterria hate most. So Hunterria will help you.
{SAY:hunterria}You have proven to be honorable opponent, unlike Old Woman. You deserve to be beaten by equally honorable opponent.
{SAY:hunterria}Mammoth read mind once more. Yes, Old Woman cannot beat you, because if anyone will beat you, it will be Hunterria.
{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria will send in dinosaur reinforcement. Use them well.
{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria hope you survive this. So we can duel another day.

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Well, Zomboss firing one of his generals would obviously benefit us.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_6: {SAY:nanny}Oh, and you've come to root for your favorite, Is that it?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_10_INTRO_7: {SAY:nanny}Well, if I'm going down, I'M TAKING YOU ALL DOWN WITH ME!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny, look! The little guys I planted last week are starting to bloom!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}That is good news User Dave, they arrived just in time for the bountiful month of harvest.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}You're right, Penny! Plants are way more productive this time of year!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Probably to get all their business done before winter comes!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Old gardener's tales and farm folklores suggest as much, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}Nevertheless, I regret to inform you that zombie activity is back on steady rise.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_8: {TIRED:winnie}It seems no matter what month it is, they're always prepared to cause our plants trouble.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}We can't have those no-good zombies ruin joyful harvest time!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria can dig more buried treasure to help for money. Hunterria recently found unexplored underwater ruin-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}No, you silly girl! A couple buried treasures won't be able to revitalize our financial situation! We're in deep trouble here!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}We don't even have money to afford that type of expedition!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_13: {SAY:zombossicon}I'm already in the tank for all the money I borrowed from ZCorp! My brother Zombillion and his interest rates...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_14: {SAY:zombossicon}This leaves me no choice! I'm going to start cutting off fruitless divisions who only hog resources with zero benefits!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_16: {SAY:zombossicon}Yes, and both of your divisions are on the chopping block.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_17: {SAY:zombossicon}It is up to you both to prove to me that your department, as well as your position- is worth keeping!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_18: {SAY:zombossicon}Otherwise, I will have to deem you a waste. And you both know what happens to waste.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}I must implore you to keep your voice down.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_21: {SAY:zombossicon}Exactly. Only one of you can stay, so prove to me you're worth more than your peer.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_22: {SAY:zombossicon}That is all, you may return to your post.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_24: {SAY:nanny}To think I could finally have a calm month for once.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_26: {NPC_EXIT:nanny}{SAY:hunterria}Wolfy. Our home is at stake. We must win boss favor by proving our worth.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_27: {SAY:hunterria}Call on your brothers. The hunt is on.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_29: {TIRED:winnie} Zomboss seems to have mistakenly connected us to his General meetings, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_31: {SAY:crazydave}Oh drat, Penny! Let's go before she notices us!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_4: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I call into motion the start of our monthly meeting. Generals, status report.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}Very well. As you both may know, we've entered what our dastardly foes would call their most productive time of the year.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}In contrast, this month has always been the slowest time for zombiekind, before it picks back up in October, the month of ghouls!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}Needless to say, this obviously affects our financial earnings as well.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria finally track scent down. Fat man and his iron mammoth has been eavesdropping.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}...then why have you placed User Dave's mold colonies on the board?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}This is a clear disadvantage for us.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_12: {SAY:crazydave}Hey, so that's why those guys aren't in my mold tank!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_13: {SAY:hunterria}This is fair. The strong must protect the weak. Hunterria will also be protecting animal friends during duel.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_14: {SAY:hunterria}Prove your honor as hunter. Protect your mold friends as we duel.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_15: {NPC_EXIT:hunterria}{SAY:winnie}Well, user Dave. I suppose we have to make do with these restrictions.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_16: {SAY:crazydave}I say game on, Penny! Neighbor, Let's prove our honor!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Well, to be fair, Boss-man was the one who added us to the call by mistake!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_3: {SAY:hunterria}This simply won't do. Such methods are dishonorable for us hunters.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_4: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria must punish Fat man for such treachery.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Are you going to report us to Zomboss?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria will not get boss involved. We settle this according to way of hunter.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:hunterria}We duel. Hunterria give you time to prepare. Hunterria wants honest and fair battle.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:hunterria}If you win duel, Hunterria will let Fat man go.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}A moment, Hunterria. If you insist on a fair battle...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{SAY:hunterria}Fat man and neighbor won battle fair and square. Hunterria recognize their resolve.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_10: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria do no such thing. Hunterria was-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_11: {SAY:nanny}Shut your trap, you primeval heathen. I am not losing my job to some... to some pet!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_12: {SAY:nanny}I can't go back to the streets. As much as I loathe it, Zomboss' protection is the only thing keeping me on my feet!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_13: {SAY:nanny}If he ever got rid of me and that fatso mafia got a wind of it...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_14: {SAY:nanny}And that's if Zomboss doesn't dispose of me first! I ain't lookin' for a one way trip 70 years to the past!

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_16: {SAY:nanny}Well, I ain't tryin' to find out! Outta the way, you neanderthal!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_17: {SAY:nanny}if anyone's gonna take credit for offin' these three, it's gonna be me!

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}You're no pushover, either, Hunterria! You put up a good fight!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria must. It is her duty as a hunter. And general to boss.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Very noble. If that's all, Hunterria, then we shall take our leave-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_6: {NPC_ENTER:nanny}{SAY:nanny}Cough. What- what's all this? What are you four up to?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_7: {SAY:hunterria}Old woman. Hunterria was dueling Fat man and his neighbor.

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_9: {SAY:nanny}Oh, I see what's going on here! Tryna win the boss' favor by offing these three first, huh? you gettin' the jump on me?

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_10: {TIRED:crazydave}Oh, geez- when you put it like that...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}I find this to be a false equivalence. User Dave has never asked me to prove my worth to him.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Hunterria, if Zomboss truly cares about you...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}...he will not threaten to abandon you when you stop being useful to him.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_14: {TIRED:crazydave}Penny! You can't just say that to her!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_15: {SAY:hunterria}That is just how boss is. Hunterria know boss very well.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_16: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria hunt you down now. To prove worth.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_17: {NPC_EXIT:hunterria}{SHOUT:crazydave}Oh no, Penny! What do we do?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_18: {SHOUT:crazydave}Just when these little flowers are in the process of blooming too!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_19: {SAY:winnie}It's likely a part of Hunterria's plan to take them hostage, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}She said it herself, she's been watching us.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}For the meantime, these spikeweeds would be able to protect the little flowers from being trampled.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_22: {SAY:winnie}I cannot guarantee their safety forever, however.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Why are you back, Hunterria? I was under the impression that our matters were settled.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:hunterria}Our duel is not over. Hunterria must still prove her worth to boss.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_5: {SAY:hunterria}Like you prove worth to the Fat man.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_6: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria has been watching you two. Your kinship with Fat man, that is what boss is to Hunterria.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_8: {SAY:hunterria}Yes: like how Fat man provide home and take care of mammoth, this is what boss does for Hunterria.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_5_INTRO_9: {SAY:hunterria}Boss cared for Hunterria. Took her from Savannah. Hunterria is only paying boss back for generosity by hunting you down.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, do you think Hunterria will show up again today?

NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_13: {SAY:nanny}What a perfect opportunity for me to swoop down here and finish the job, after she already softened you up!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_14: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Sheesh, Granny. You're really just gonna take advantage of a friend like that?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_15: {SAY:nanny}She's not my friend. No mutt loyal to Zomboss will ever be! Bah!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_16: {SAY:nanny}You weaklings won't be able to fight off my swarm of brats today!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_17: {SAY:nanny}I've injected them with Zomboss' potent boost formula!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_18: {SAY:nanny}Let's see how these imps fare against your plants! HA-HA-HA!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}It is likely she is taking time to recuperate herself, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Phew! We can finally lay low for a while!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_6: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I've grown quite a liking to her- she's a zombie and all...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_7: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}But when she's not trying to kill us, she's surprisingly agreeable!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}I'm afraid my impression upon her remains a negative one, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Nevertheless, even with her absent, this does not mean no other zombie couldn't-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:hunterria}{SAY:hunterria}Hunterria apologize for not showing up yesterday. Hunterria was tending to Wolfy's offsprings.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_10: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria has asked a favor from her flying friends.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_11: {TIRED:winnie}And just like that, she managed to upend us. Like a cat cornering a little mouse.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:crazydave}As expected from a hunter! Well played, Hunterria!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Why are you congratulating her, User Dave?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_14: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey, when someone manages to outwit you, you just gotta stop and give them their dues!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_15: {SAY:hunterria}Boss rarely praise Hunterria, so Hunterria appreciate this. Thank you, Fat man.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_17: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Boss man should compliment you for all the hard work you've done!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_18: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria doesn't think so. Praise is not necessary to be an effective hunter.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_19: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria will be seeing you on boss dinner plate later. Goodbye.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}No worries! We were busy watering our crops too!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_20: {NPC_EXIT:hunterria}{SAY:crazydave}Man, that girl's a spitfire! Wouldn't you say so, Penny?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_21: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, one of her weasels just got in your pants.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_3: {SAY:hunterria}Today, our duel continue. Hunterria will attempt to win boss favor again.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_4: {SAY:hunterria}Hunterria told her critter friend to steal your seeds.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}What- hey! Give those packets back, you slimy weasels!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_6: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Do not worry, User Dave. I've managed to preserve some of the seed packets.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}A cacophony of flying specimens seem to be blocking the sky today, limiting our sun gain.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_8_INTRO_9: {SAY:crazydave}Wah, everything's up there! Pterodactyls, dodos, pelicans!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2025_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:nanny}{SPECIAL1:nanny}You little rat! Why do you have to make this so @#$%! difficult!?
